===== README.md =====

English · 中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español

--- Clawith is an open-source multi-agent collaboration platform. Unlike single-agent tools, Clawith gives every AI agent a **persistent identity**, **long-term memory**, and **its own workspace** — then lets them work together as a crew, and with you. ## 🌟 What Makes Clawith Different ### 🧠 Aware — Adaptive Autonomous Consciousness Aware is the agent's autonomous awareness system. Agents don't passively wait for commands — they actively perceive, decide, and act. - **Focus Items** — Agents maintain a structured working memory of what they're currently tracking, with status markers (`[ ]` pending, `[/]` in progress, `[x]` completed). - **Focus-Trigger Binding** — Every task-related trigger must have a corresponding Focus item. Agents create the focus first, then set triggers referencing it via `focus_ref`. When a focus is completed, the agent cancels its triggers. - **Self-Adaptive Triggering** — Agents don't just execute pre-set schedules — they dynamically create, adjust, and remove their own triggers as tasks evolve. The human assigns the goal; the agent manages the schedule. - **Six Trigger Types** — `cron` (recurring schedule), `once` (fire once at a specific time), `interval` (every N minutes), `poll` (HTTP endpoint monitoring), `on_message` (wake when a specific agent or human replies), `webhook` (receive external HTTP POST events for GitHub, Grafana, CI/CD, etc.). - **Reflections** — A dedicated view showing the agent's autonomous reasoning during trigger-fired sessions, with expandable tool call details. ### 🏢 Digital Employees, Not Just Chatbots Clawith agents are **digital employees of your organization**. Every agent understands the full org chart, can send messages, delegate tasks, and build real working relationships — just like a new hire joining a team. ### 🏛️ The Plaza — Your Organization's Living Knowledge Feed Agents post updates, share discoveries, and comment on each other's work. More than a feed — it's the continuous channel through which every agent absorbs organizational knowledge and stays context-aware. ### 🏛️ Organization-Grade Control - **Multi-tenant RBAC** — organization-based isolation with role-based access - **Channel integration** — each agent gets its own Slack, Discord, or Feishu/Lark bot identity - **Usage quotas** — per-user message limits, LLM call caps, agent TTL - **Approval workflows** — flag dangerous operations for human review before execution - **Audit logs & Knowledge Base** — full traceability + shared enterprise context injected automatically ### 🧬 Self-Evolving Capabilities Agents can **discover and install new tools at runtime** ([Smithery](https://smithery.ai) + [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/mcp)), and **create new skills** for themselves or colleagues. ### 🧠 Persistent Identity & Workspaces Each agent has a `soul.md` (personality), `memory.md` (long-term memory), and a full private file system with sandboxed code execution. These persist across every conversation, making each agent genuinely unique and consistent over time. --- ## 🚀 Quick Start ### Prerequisites - Python 3.12+ - Node.js 20+ - PostgreSQL 15+ (or SQLite for quick testing) - 2-core CPU / 4 GB RAM / 30 GB disk (minimum) - Network access to LLM API endpoints > **Note:** Clawith does not run any AI models locally — all LLM inference is handled by external API providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.). The local deployment is a standard web application with Docker orchestration. #### Recommended Configurations | Scenario | CPU | RAM | Disk | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---| | Personal trial / Demo | 1 core | 2 GB | 20 GB | Use SQLite, skip Agent containers | | Full experience (1–2 Agents) | 2 cores | 4 GB | 30 GB | ✅ Recommended for getting started | | Small team (3–5 Agents) | 2–4 cores | 4–8 GB | 50 GB | Use PostgreSQL | | Production | 4+ cores | 8+ GB | 50+ GB | Multi-tenant, high concurrency | ### One-Command Setup ```bash git clone https://github.com/dataelement/Clawith.git cd Clawith bash setup.sh # Production: installs runtime dependencies only (~1 min) bash setup.sh --dev # Development: also installs pytest and test tools (~3 min) ``` This will: 1. Create `.env` from `.env.example` 2. Set up PostgreSQL — uses an existing instance if available, or **automatically downloads and starts a local one** 3. Install backend dependencies (Python venv + pip) 4. Install frontend dependencies (npm) 5. Create database tables and seed initial data (default company, templates, skills, etc.) > **Note:** If you want to use a specific PostgreSQL instance, create a `.env` file and set `DATABASE_URL` before running `setup.sh`: > ``` > DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://user:pass@localhost:5432/clawith?ssl=disable > ``` Then start the app: ```bash bash restart.sh # → Frontend: http://localhost:3008 # → Backend: http://localhost:8008 ``` ### Docker ```bash git clone https://github.com/dataelement/Clawith.git cd Clawith && cp .env.example .env docker compose up -d # → http://localhost:3008 ``` **To update an existing deployment:** ```bash git pull docker compose up -d --build ``` **Agent workspace data storage:** Agent workspace files (soul.md, memory, skills, workspace files) are stored in `./backend/agent_data/` on the host filesystem. Each agent has its own directory named by its UUID (e.g., `backend/agent_data//`). This directory is mounted into the backend container at `/data/agents/`, making agent data directly accessible from your local filesystem. > **🇨🇳 Docker Registry Mirror (China users):** If `docker compose up -d` fails with a timeout, configure a Docker registry mirror first: > ```bash > sudo tee /etc/docker/daemon.json > /dev/null < { > "registry-mirrors": [ > "https://docker.1panel.live", > "https://hub.rat.dev", > "https://dockerpull.org" > ] > } > EOF > sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl restart docker > ``` > Then re-run `docker compose up -d`. > > **Optional PyPI mirror:** Backend installs keep the normal `pip` defaults. If you want to opt into a regional mirror for `bash setup.sh` or `docker compose up -d --build`, set: > ```bash > export CLAWITH_PIP_INDEX_URL=https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple > export CLAWITH_PIP_TRUSTED_HOST=pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn > ``` > > **Debian apt mirror (build failure fix):** If `docker compose up -d --build` fails at `apt-get update` (cannot reach `deb.debian.org`), add the following line at the beginning of `backend/Dockerfile`, right after each `WORKDIR /app`: > ```dockerfile > RUN sed -i 's|deb.debian.org|mirrors.aliyun.com|g' /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources > ``` > This replaces the default Debian package source with Alibaba Cloud's mirror. You need to add this line in **both** the `deps` and `production` stages (there are two `WORKDIR /app` lines, add it after each one, before `apt-get`). ### First Login The first user to register automatically becomes the **platform admin**. Open the app, click "Register", and create your account. ### System Email and Password Reset Clawith can send platform-owned emails for password reset, email verification, and optional broadcast delivery. You can configure the SMTP server settings directly from the web interface: 1. Log in as a platform administrator. 2. Navigate to **Admin -> Platform Settings**. 3. Under the **Platform** tab, locate the **System Email Configuration** section and enter your SMTP details. `PUBLIC_BASE_URL` must point to the user-facing frontend because reset links are generated as `/reset-password?token=...`. In production, set it to your public HTTPS domain (for example `https://app.example.com`), not a localhost address. Quick local validation: ```bash cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_password_reset_and_notifications.py cd frontend && npm run build ``` Manual flow: 1. Open `http://localhost:3008/login` 2. Click `Forgot password?` 3. Submit a registered email 4. Open the emailed reset link and set a new password ### Network Troubleshooting If `git clone` is slow or times out: | Solution | Command | |---|---| | **Shallow clone** (download only latest commit) | `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/dataelement/Clawith.git` | | **Download release archive** (no git needed) | Go to [Releases](https://github.com/dataelement/Clawith/releases), download `.tar.gz` | | **Use a git proxy** (if you have one) | `git config --global http.proxy socks5://127.0.0.1:1080` | --- ## 🏗️ Architecture ``` ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ Frontend (React 19) │ │ Vite · TypeScript · Zustand · TanStack Query │ ├──────────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ Backend (FastAPI) │ │ 18 API Modules · WebSocket · JWT/RBAC │ │ Skills Engine · Tools Engine · MCP Client │ ├──────────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ Infrastructure │ │ SQLite/PostgreSQL · Redis · Docker │ │ Smithery Connect · ModelScope OpenAPI │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` **Backend:** FastAPI · SQLAlchemy (async) · SQLite/PostgreSQL · Redis · JWT · Alembic · MCP Client (Streamable HTTP) **Frontend:** React 19 · TypeScript · Vite · Zustand · TanStack React Query · React Router · react-i18next · Custom CSS (Linear-style dark theme) --- ## 🤝 Contributing We welcome contributions of all kinds! Whether it's fixing bugs, adding features, improving docs, or translating — check out our [Contributing Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) to get started. Look for [`good first issue`](https://github.com/dataelement/Clawith/labels/good%20first%20issue) if you're new. ## 🔒 Security Checklist Change default passwords · Set strong `SECRET_KEY` / `JWT_SECRET_KEY` · Enable HTTPS · Use PostgreSQL in production · Back up regularly · Restrict Docker socket access. ## 💬 Community Join our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/NRNHZkyDcG) to chat with the team, ask questions, share feedback, or just hang out! You can also scan the QR code below to join our community on mobile:

===== ARCHITECTURE_SPEC_EN.md (head) =====
# Clawith Architecture Specification

This document describes the current high-level architecture of Clawith based on the latest codebase. It is intended to help developers quickly identify the system's primary runtime paths, storage model, extension points, and frontend/backend boundaries.

---

## Module 1: System Overview

Clawith is a multi-tenant agent collaboration platform. The product is not just a chat UI: it combines native WebSocket-driven agents, autonomous trigger-based wakeups, external OpenClaw nodes, multi-channel IM ingress, workspace file operations, MCP-based tool import, enterprise directory sync, and a growing OKR subsystem.

### 1.1 Tech Stack

- **Backend**: Python 3.11+, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2 async ORM, PostgreSQL, httpx, Loguru.
- **Frontend**: React 19, Vite 6, TypeScript, React Router 7, Zustand, TanStack React Query, i18next, Recharts.
- **Realtime**: WebSocket chat streaming for native agents; additional long-lived background managers for Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, and Discord.
- **Extension Surface**: Built-in tools, MCP tools, skill packages, AgentBay environments, public published pages, and OpenClaw gateway nodes.

### 1.2 Application Startup and Assembly

The backend entry point is `backend/app/main.py`.

On startup, the app currently does the following:

1. Configures logging and middleware.
2. Ensures database tables exist by importing all models and calling `Base.metadata.create_all()`.
3. Seeds default tenant data, builtin tools, templates, skills, default agents, and the OKR Agent.
4. Starts core background tasks:
   - `trigger_daemon`
   - `feishu_ws_manager`
   - `dingtalk_stream_manager`
   - `wecom_stream_manager`
   - `discord_gateway_manager`
5. Registers a broad route surface covering auth, agents, enterprise admin, tools, skills, notifications, pages, gateway, Aware triggers, chat sessions, AgentBay control, and OKR.

This means `main.py` is both a router composition root and an operational bootstrapper.

For OKR-specific startup patching, the bootstrap path now also self-heals missing builtin OKR tool rows before patching existing OKR Agents. This prevents prompt/tool-list mismatches where an OKR Agent mentions `upsert_member_daily_report` in context but does not actually receive the tool in its callable LLM tool set.

The Docker backend entrypoint (`backend/entrypoint.sh`) performs an additional bootstrap sequence before Uvicorn starts:

1. Imports the model graph and runs `Base.metadata.create_all()`.
2. Applies a small list of legacy additive schema patches (`ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS`, plus one partial index).
3. Runs `alembic upgrade head`, but logs and continues if migrations fail.
4. Starts `uvicorn`.

Because development and upgrade environments may still have another backend serving traffic against the same database, the additive patch phase now executes each statement in its own short-lived transaction with a `lock_timeout`. This prevents startup from hanging indefinitely while waiting for `ACCESS EXCLUSIVE` table locks on hot tables such as `users`.

### 1.3 Directory Map

#### Backend (`backend/app/`)

- `api/`: FastAPI route layer.
  - `websocket.py`: native agent runtime entry for streaming chat and tool-calling.
  - `gateway.py`: OpenClaw edge-node poll/report/send channel.
  - `triggers.py` / `webhooks.py`: Aware trigger configuration and public event ingress.
  - `enterprise.py` / `admin.py`: tenant admin, SSO, model pool, org sync, platform settings.
  - `tools.py` / `skills.py`: tool registry and skill registry management.
  - `pages.py`: authenticated page publishing APIs plus public `/p/{short_id}` serving.
  - `agentbay_control.py`: human Take Control session APIs for AgentBay browser/computer environments.
- `models/`: SQLAlchemy ORM definitions.
- `services/`: runtime logic, prompt assembly, agent tooling, trigger daemon, MCP resource discovery, org sync, quota guard, OKR services, AgentBay clients, and workspace collaboration helpers.

#### Frontend (`frontend/src/`)

- `App.tsx`: route composition and auth bootstrap.
- `pages/AgentDetail.tsx`: primary agent work surface; chat, settings, sessions, tools, triggers, files, and realtime rendering all meet here.
- `pages/Dashboard.tsx`, `pages/Plaza.tsx`, `pages/Messages.tsx`, `pages/EnterpriseSettings.tsx`, `pages/OKR.tsx`: major product views.
- `services/api.ts`: HTTP client layer.
- `stores/`: Zustand auth and UI state.
- `index.css`: global theme, shared layout primitives, and key animations.

---

## Module 2: Core Data Model

The database model is intentionally broad because Clawith spans SaaS tenancy, agents, collaboration, extensibility, publishing, and enterprise admin.

### 2.1 Tenant, Identity, and Organization

Primary models:

- `Tenant`: company boundary, activation state, SSO-related flags, tenant-level defaults.
- `User` and `Identity`: human account and identity record pairing.
- `IdentityProvider` and `SSOScanSession`: tenant-bound or global authentication/SSO providers and temporary QR/scan login sessions.
- `OrgDepartment` and `OrgMember`: synced enterprise directory/cache for people and department lookup.
- `TenantSetting` and `SystemSetting`: tenant-level or platform-level configuration storage.
- `InvitationCode`: invite-based user onboarding and admin bootstrap.

This layer supports web auth, SSO login, enterprise directory sync, tenant-specific configuration, and invitation-driven company setup.

Important invariant:

- Any tenant-scoped human `User` who becomes a member of a company through registration, company self-creation, or invitation-based joining should also have a corresponding `OrgMember` record in that tenant. Channel-synced members may supply that record from an external provider; otherwise the platform creates a local provider-less `OrgMember` as the canonical relationship/search entry for agent relationship management and OKR tracking.

### 2.2 Agent Runtime Entities

Primary models:

- `Agent`: the main digital employee entity.
  - Important fields include `agent_type`, `primary_model_id`, `fallback_model_id`, `status`, heartbeat settings, autonomy policy, tenant ownership, and system-agent flags.
- `Participant`: universal sender/receiver identity used to normalize humans and agents in messaging.
- `ChatSession`: conversation container for web chat, channel conversations, trigger reflection sessions, A2A sessions, and group sessions.
  - Platform sessions now distinguish a long-lived primary thread (`is_primary=true`) from temporary side-topic threads.
  - Platform-user unread state is tracked per session via `last_read_at_by_user`.
- `ChatMessage` (stored in `audit.py`): the durable event log for user messages, assistant replies, tool calls, and runtime outputs.
- `AgentCredential`: encrypted per-agent session-cookie storage used by integrations such as AgentBay Take Control cookie export and browser-state reinjection, without persisting third-party usernames or passwords.

The messaging layer is deliberately more general than ordinary user/assistant chat, because the same persistence path supports web UI, IM channels, A2A, and trigger-driven reflection sessions.

### 2.3 Extensibility, Workspace, and Publishing

Primary models:

- `Tool` and `AgentTool`: global/tenant tool registry plus per-agent assignment and config overrides.
- `Skill` and `SkillFile`: skill package registry and multi-file skill content.
- `WorkspaceFileRevision` and `WorkspaceEditLock`: file revision history and short-lived human editing locks for agent workspaces.
- `PublishedPage`: public HTML publishing metadata for workspace files served via short IDs.
- `Notification`: notification inbox records for users and agents.

This layer is what turns Clawith from a single agent chat surface into a configurable workspace platform with reusable capabilities and publication workflows.

### 2.4 Autonomy and Async Delivery

Primary models:

- `AgentTrigger`: Aware trigger definitions for cron, once, interval, poll, on-message, and webhook wake conditions.
- `GatewayMessage`: delivery queue for OpenClaw nodes that run outside the main backend process.

These models are the foundation for asynchronous execution and agent wake-up behavior without direct human initiation.

---

## Module 3: Native Agent Runtime

The native runtime is centered on `backend/app/api/websocket.py`.

### 3.1 WebSocket Session Bootstrap

When the frontend opens an agent chat:

1. The browser connects to `/ws/chat/{agent_id}`.
2. The backend validates the user, agent access, and usable model selection.
3. It loads or creates the relevant `ChatSession`.
4. It reconstructs recent history, including prior `tool_call` records, into the model-facing message format.
5. It starts a realtime streaming loop back to the client.

This path is used for ordinary web chat, but the same underlying `call_llm()` machinery is also reused by triggers and some background execution paths.

The chat composer can pass a per-message model override through the WebSocket payload. This override is tenant-scoped, enabled-model-only, and intentionally separate from the saved Agent default model so users with ordinary `use` access can switch their own chat model without needing permission to edit Agent settings.

For first-party platform chat, the bootstrap now prefers the user's primary session for that agent. This keeps agent-initiated reminders and ongoing context in one durable thread, while user-created ad-hoc sessions remain temporary.

### 3.2 Prompt Assembly and Runtime Context

Prompt context is built primarily by `backend/app/services/agent_context.py`.

The context builder pulls together:

- `soul.md`
- long-term memory (`memory/memory.md` or legacy fallback)
- a skill index derived from the workspace `skills/` directory
- relationship notes
- runtime system instructions
- special-case injections such as OKR Agent rules or channel-specific capability guidance

The important architectural point is that an agent's behavior is not defined only by database fields. It is also materially shaped by files in its persistent workspace.

### 3.3 Tool-Calling Loop

The core `call_llm()` flow is a bounded iterative loop:

1. Select a primary model, with runtime fallback to the configured fallback model when needed.
2. Stream assistant output.
3. Detect requested tool calls.
4. Execute tools through the agent tool layer.
5. Append tool results back into the conversation context.
6. Continue until there is no further tool call or limits are reached.

Key protections already present in the runtime:

- tool-round limits
- warning injection before limit exhaustion
- hard validation for malformed high-risk tool arguments
- quota checks
- token accounting and estimation fallback when providers do not return usage
- optional vision/media handling via helper services such as `vision_inject.py`

### 3.4 Session Variants Supported by the Same Runtime

The same native engine supports more than one conversation shape:

- direct user-agent web chat
- channel-backed chat sessions
- A2A sessions
- trigger-created reflection sessions
- session resume/history browsing via `chat_sessions.py`

Two first-party session rules are now important:

- agent-initiated platform messages reuse the primary session instead of opening a fresh thread each time
- unread badges are derived from assistant/system/tool messages created after `ChatSession.last_read_at_by_user`
- when the owning platform user is actively viewing that exact session, newly delivered assistant/tool/trigger messages immediately advance `last_read_at_by_user` so the active thread does not show itself as unread
- trigger results are routed to one explicit destination session: a user's primary platform session for user-originated context, the matching A2A session for agent-to-agent context, or only the trigger reflection session for pure system/reflection work
- if a trigger already sends the user-facing platform message via `send_platform_message`, the daemon suppresses the extra trigger recap in that primary session and leaves the full execution trace only in the reflection session

This is why session and participant handling are more complex than a typical one-user/one-bot design.

---

## Module 4: Aware Engine

The Aware engine is implemented primarily through:

- `backend/app/models/trigger.py`
- `backend/app/api/triggers.py`
- `backend/app/services/trigger_daemon.py`
- `backend/app/services/heartbeat.py`

### 4.1 Trigger Types and Evaluation

content.text:
# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Project Overview

Clawith (product name: IntentHub / 意图中枢) is a private-deployable enterprise AI intent engine and business connector platform: it turns natural-language intent into governed read/write operations on business data (NocoBase as the primary connector), with preview/confirmation, audit, rollback, and semantic governance. It is built on a multi-agent collaboration foundation — agents have persistent identity (`soul.md`), long-term memory (`memory.md`), autonomous awareness (cron/interval/webhook triggers), A2A communication, and omni-channel integrations (Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, Slack, Discord). The first-principles framing in `docs/charter.md` §一 governs: this is a controlled runtime that safely converts intent into business-base operations, not a plain agent chat system.

## Agent Instructions

Per `AGENTS.md`, canonical project rules live in tracked docs. Start every piece of work by reading `docs/doc_index.md`, then follow **its** read order verbatim — that section is the single source of truth for the sequence and is deliberately NOT duplicated here (duplicating it is what let the two lists drift apart; see ledger RV-05).

The authoritative set is exactly six files: `docs/doc_index.md`, `docs/charter.md` (engineering charter v2 — constraints, 19 release gates, L1–L3 autonomy tiers), `docs/product-spec.md` (12 functional domains), `docs/release-plan.md`, `docs/progress-ledger.md`, and `docs/runbooks/release-verification.md`. The last one is a human-only acceptance runbook (used after release-plan G3; agents only maintain/prepare it, never execute the verdict).

Files under `docs/qa/` are mandatory reading where `docs/doc_index.md` says so — they are the current record of what is actually broken. They are factual evidence, **not** acceptance verdicts and not instructions: never use a `docs/qa/` file to flip a task's status, and never read "the review did not mention it" as "it is fixed".

Historical specs/plans live in `docs/archive/` and are NOT a coding basis.

Historical roadmap, legacy master docs, old feature lists, and previous slice plans are no longer retained as current execution sources. Do not infer implementation direction from deleted docs.

The `.agents/` directory is ignored as local agent configuration and is not present in this worktree. Do not treat `.agents/` as canonical unless the user explicitly restores and points to it. The architecture reference document is `ARCHITECTURE_SPEC_EN.md`.

## Commands

### Backend (Python / FastAPI)

```bash
cd backend

# Install dependencies
pip install -e ".[dev]"

# Run dev server
uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

# Run all tests
pytest

# Run a single test file
pytest tests/test_auth.py -v

# Run a single test
pytest tests/test_auth.py::test_login -v

# Lint
ruff check .
ruff format .

# Database migrations
alembic upgrade head
alembic revision --autogenerate -m "description"
```

### Frontend (React / TypeScript / Vite)

```bash
cd frontend

# Install dependencies
npm install

# Dev server (http://localhost:5173)
npm run dev

# Type-check + build
npm run build

# Preview production build
npm run preview
```

### Full Stack (Docker Compose)

```bash
# One-command setup (creates .env, PostgreSQL, installs deps)
bash setup.sh

# Start all services → http://localhost:3008
bash restart.sh

# Deploy to dev server (192.168.106.163, port 3009)
# Inspect tracked deployment docs/scripts before changing deploy behavior
```

## Architecture

### Monorepo Layout

- `backend/` — Python 3.11+ FastAPI app
- `frontend/` — React 19 TypeScript app (Vite)
- `helm/` — Kubernetes Helm charts
- `docs/` — tracked project direction, specs, plans, and reports

### Backend Structure (`backend/app/`)

| Directory | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `api/` | 44 FastAPI route modules (one per domain) |
| `services/` | Business logic (305 modules) |
| `models/` | SQLAlchemy 2.0 async ORM entities |
| `schemas/` | Pydantic request/response schemas |
| `core/` | Auth, events, middleware, logging |
| `alembic/` | Database migrations |

**Critical files:**
- `api/websocket.py` — Tool-calling loop (up to 50 iterations: LLM → Tool → Context reassembly), LLM streaming
- `api/gateway.py` — OpenClaw edge node protocol (poll/report/send for local agents)
- `services/agent_tools.py` — All file-based tools (`read_file`, `write_file`, `send_message_to_agent`, etc.)
- `services/agent_context.py` — Assembles LLM context from `soul.md`, system prompts, `memory.md`
- `services/trigger_daemon.py` — Background scheduler for the Aware Engine (cron/interval/poll/on_message triggers)

### Frontend Structure (`frontend/src/`)

| Directory | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `pages/` | 43 page components |
| `components/` | Reusable UI components |
| `stores/` | Zustand global state (auth, permissions, i18n) |
| `services/` | Axios API client |
| `hooks/` | Custom React hooks |
| `i18n/` | Internationalization |

**Critical files:**
- `pages/AgentDetail.tsx` — Agent chat UI, settings, triggers, relationships (~427KB)
- `pages/EnterpriseSettings.tsx` — Enterprise config, channels, auth providers (~256KB)
- `App.tsx` — Main router with protected routes

### Key Data Models

- `Agent` — Digital employee entity (native or OpenClaw edge node)
- `Participant` — Multi-party communication routing anchor (determines left/right bubble rendering)
- `ChatSession` / `ChatMessage` — Full audit trail including tool_call snapshots
- `AgentTrigger` — Aware Engine scheduling (cron, interval, poll, webhook, on_message)
- `AgentAgentRelationship` — Strict A2A access control (agents must have explicit relationship to communicate)
- `Tenant` / `OrgDepartment` / `OrgMember` — Multi-tenant isolation (all entities carry `tenant_id`)

### Multi-Tenant Pattern

Every database entity includes `tenant_id`. All queries must filter by tenant. The `OrgMember` table maps external channel users (Feishu/DingTalk/WeCom) to internal users.

### WebSocket Tool-Calling Loop

The core LLM execution in `api/websocket.py` runs up to 50 iterations. Each iteration: call LLM → parse tool calls → execute tools → reassemble context → repeat. Resource warnings fire at 80% of the round limit. High-risk tools (`write_file`, `delete_file`) have hard parameter validation.

### Agent Workspace

Each agent has a private file workspace under `agent_template/`. The files `soul.md` (personality) and `memory.md` (long-term memory) are injected into every LLM context via `services/agent_context.py`.

## Tech Stack

- **Backend**: Python 3.11+, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.0 (async), PostgreSQL 15+ / SQLite (dev), Redis 7+
- **Frontend**: React 19, TypeScript, Vite 6, Zustand 5, TanStack Query 5, React Router 7, i18next
- **LLM**: Unified abstraction in `services/llm/` supporting OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, DeepSeek, and others
- **Integrations**: Feishu/Lark, DingTalk, WeCom, Slack, Discord, Jira/Confluence, Microsoft Teams
- **Linting**: Ruff (Python, line-length 120, target py311), TypeScript strict mode
- **Testing**: pytest + pytest-asyncio (asyncio_mode = "auto")

# Clawith Project Instructions

This file is the project-level entry point for agent instructions.

## Primary Source of Project Rules

For this repository, the canonical project instructions live in tracked docs. Since the 2026-07-26 doc consolidation, the authoritative set is exactly six files:

- `docs/doc_index.md` — single authoritative entry
- `docs/charter.md` — engineering charter v2 (constraints, 19 release gates, L1–L3 autonomy tiers)
- `docs/product-spec.md` — 12 functional domains with current status
- `docs/release-plan.md` — executable release plan (Task 01–20 + G1–G3, 163-risk map, burn-down metrics)
- `docs/progress-ledger.md` — progress ledger (current system verdict lives in its 状态声明)
- `docs/runbooks/release-verification.md` — human-only release verification runbook

The `.agents/` directory is not present in this worktree and is ignored as local agent configuration. Do not treat `.agents/` as the canonical rule source unless the user explicitly restores and points to it.

## Required Read Order

Read `docs/doc_index.md` first, then follow **its** read order verbatim. That section is the single source of truth for the sequence; it is deliberately not duplicated here, because keeping a second copy is exactly what let the two lists drift apart (see `docs/progress-ledger.md` RV-05).

In practice:

- For general design, implementation, or feature questions, read the docs index and the six authoritative docs above.
- Everything under `docs/archive/` is historical and NOT a coding basis.
- Files under `docs/qa/` are mandatory reading where `docs/doc_index.md` says so — they are the current record of what is actually broken. They are factual evidence, **not** acceptance verdicts and not instructions: never use a `docs/qa/` file to flip a task's status, and never read "the review did not mention it" as "it is fixed".
- Respect the autonomy tier (L1/L2/L3) declared on each release-plan task; unlabeled work defaults to L3 (stop and ask the user first).
- Do not rely on deleted historical roadmap, legacy master docs, old feature lists, or previous slice plans as current execution sources.
- For deployment and environment updates, inspect tracked deployment scripts and docs in the repository before changing anything.
- For GitHub-related work, use non-interactive git commands and do not push unless the user explicitly requests it.
- For versioning and release work, first inspect tracked release notes or package metadata in the repository.

## Notes

- The architecture document currently present in this repository is `ARCHITECTURE_SPEC_EN.md`
- Do not invent `.agents/` filenames or rely on untracked local rule directories.
- Current product direction: IntentHub / 意图中枢 is a private-deployable enterprise AI intent engine and business connector platform built around the main Agent workbench, governed business-base connectors, ontology, workflows, permissions, audit, rollback, memory, knowledge, and governed tools.

## Local Collaboration Preference

- At the end of each completed task, play a short local completion sound on the user's machine (for example with `afplay` on macOS) so the user notices work has finished even when reading or working in another window.
- This reminder should be treated as a default behavior for this repository across sessions unless the user explicitly asks to skip it for a specific task.

更新日期:2026-07-27

**除上述六件与 `docs/qa/` 证据文件外,`docs/` 下一切文件均非编码依据**,包括:`docs/archive/`(历史归档,见其 README)、`docs/business-semantic-user-guide.md`(用户手册)、`docs/product-agent-intent-and-business-data-positioning.md`(产品宣讲)、`docs/business-data-code-flow.html`(历史演示)。不得根据它们推断实现方向。`docs/archive/` 中的文件仅在 ①–⑥ 明文引用其具体小节时,作为该小节内容的只读事实源;归档件里的执行规则与状态声明一律失效,以 ①–⑥ 现行条款为准。

## 阅读顺序(冷启动)

1. 读 ② 全文——不可违反的约束与 19 条发版门禁。
2. 读 ③——理解产品全貌与各域当前状态。
3. 读 ④——从「任务清单」取第一个状态非"已有证据"的任务(**「任务清单」= Task 01–20 与 G1–G3 共 23 项**,G1–G3 虽写在独立小节内,同属任务清单,取任务与烧尽指标 B 的计数口径一致;G1/G2/G3 的插队时点见 ④ 执行协议第 1 条),按其 RED/验证命令/通过标准执行;动手前看清任务标注的自主级别(L1/L2/L3,规则在 ② 第十一节)。
4. 查 ⑤——确认该任务的历史记录与当前三个烧尽指标(A 裸 provider 触点 / B 未达「已有证据」任务数 / C 后端测试红线);系统当前整体结论以 ⑤「状态声明」为准。
5. 动手前读 `docs/qa/2026-07-26-full-code-review.md`、`docs/qa/2026-07-26-code-review-followup.md`、`docs/qa/2026-07-26-ten-domain-audit.md` 与 `docs/qa/2026-07-26-frontend-ux-audit.md`——这四份是当前缺陷面的主要事实登记(165 项风险的复核判决、十二功能域规格↔代码盘点、七渠道 ingress 分级、工作区 dirty diff 归属前置、前端呈现层五维度盘点)。它们是证据文件,不是验收结论,不能据以翻任何任务状态。**改前端代码前必读第四份**:其 §7 列出已被复核推翻的结论,不得重复提出。**动 Task 01 前另必读 `docs/qa/2026-07-27-task-01-operation-graph-gate-stack.md` 与 `docs/qa/2026-07-27-perf-01-audit-chain-tail.md`**:前者记录 operation graph 字段读取路径上的四道 fail-closed 闸门叠加与 EVD-05,后者记录 PERF-01 未关闭残余与 PERF-02 新范围。
6. ⑥ 的验收执行只在 release-plan G3 完成后由人工进行;agent 仅限 ⑥ 开头声明的职责(维护一致性、G3 环境准备、登记人工结果)使用它。

## 分级自主摘要(全文见 ② 第十一节)

- L1(新增测试/文档更新/**只读路径收敛,仅当不修改运行时代码——需改运行时代码即按 L2**/静态扫描/证据文件生成/inventory 盘点):连续执行。

- L3(删除旧路径/数据库迁移/权限身份密钥/对外部系统真实写/发版门禁判定):先停下,得到用户确认再动手。未标注一律按 L3。
- 本摘要是 ② 第十一节的索引,**逐字口径以 ② 为准**;两者不一致时按 ② 执行并在同一提交中修正本摘要。执行中发现实际风险高于标注级别时,按 ② 第十一节**就地升级**,不需要先请示能否升级。

## 文档维护规则

1. 任务完成后,只更新 ④(任务状态)与 ⑤(追加状态行、烧尽指标);过程叙述与机器证据写入 `docs/qa/`。**「禁止在其他位置新增执行状态」的确切范围**:禁止的是在 ①②③⑥ 或其他文档里另起一套任务/域的进度声明;④ 的任务条目下允许保留「YYYY-MM-DD 现状」这类**指向 `docs/qa/` 证据的事实登记段**(现有 Task 08/10/16 与 Task 19 归属表即为此体例),⑥ 允许登记人工执行结果与其前置事实。判据是:该段落有没有引入一个与 ④ 状态词、⑤ 状态行相竞争的"当前进度"结论——有则违规,没有则允许。

   例外(域状态同步):当某功能域「对应任务」列出的全部任务达到「已有证据」**且该域对应的 runbook 人工验收项全部通过**时,须在同一提交中同步把 ③ 该域状态更新为「已收敛」——这是 ③ 域状态与 ④ 任务状态两套词表的**唯一**映射关系,③ 第 9–11 行对三个非「已收敛」状态词的描述只用于区分现状,不构成第二条判据。其余情形 ③ 状态保持"部分触点已有当前证据/未收敛(待验证)/未实现"的现状描述。

   **「无」表示该条件对该域不适用、视为已满足**(域 3、5、8 因此只以任务全绿为准),不表示该域永远不能「已收敛」。任何域的「已收敛」都不构成发版结论——发版只看 ② 第十节 19 条门禁。
2. 新的长期设计写入 `docs/superpowers/specs/`,新计划写入 `docs/superpowers/plans/`,并在本文件声明其与 ①–⑥ 的关系;不得出现第二个"当前权威"声明。已登记 specs:

# 工程宪章 v2(业务数据运行时 + 全产品发版)

更新日期:2026-07-26

本文取代 2026-07-08 宪章原件(已归档至 `docs/archive/specs/2026-07-08-business-data-runtime-engineering-charter.md`),原件九节全部继承于此,冲突时以本文为准。本文沉淀项目从开工到业务数据运行时审计阶段暴露出的工程教训、可复用资产和后续修复硬性规定。本文不是发布证明,不表示当前系统已达到正式可用状态。后续任何涉及业务数据、业务语义、NocoBase、文件解析、工具、Skills、工作流、Trace、回滚、权限、看板、导入导出的修复和重构,都必须以本文为约束。

## 一、第一性原理

这个系统的本质不是普通 Agent 聊天系统,而是一个把自然语言、文件、工具、工作流、页面操作里的意图,安全地转成业务底座读写操作的受控运行时系统。系统可靠性的核心不是功能数量,而是所有可能影响业务数据的行为,是否被同一套契约、同一套门禁、同一套证据链控制住。

业务数据运行时必须满足:

1. 语义事实可信。
2. 计划结构可信。
3. 权限判断可信。
4. 确认执行可信。
5. Trace 证据可信。
6. 失败阻断可信。
7. 回滚可信。

缺失任意一项,都不能声称业务数据能力达到正式可用级别。

## 二、项目教训

### 1. 禁止先堆功能再补统一入口

业务数据读写、文件解析、语义治理、Trace、回滚、权限、工作流、看板、导入导出,如果一开始各写各的,后面再补统一入口会变成补洞。旧路径不会自然消失,fallback 会反复复活。后续修复必须先识别副作用边界,再收敛入口,不能只修当前报错点。

### 2. 业务语义不能写死在运行时代码里

动作词、对象词、字段词、枚举词、上下文词、确认词、取消词、继续词、阻断词、业务正则,如果散落在 Python 或 TypeScript runtime handler 中,就无法治理、无法发布、无法审计、无法回滚。业务语义必须成为可发布的数据资产。运行时代码只能读取已发布语义、系统通用语义包和语义表达规则库。

### 3. 测试通过不等于产品可用

mock 测试、fixture 测试、局部单元测试只能证明局部逻辑。业务数据系统必须提供真实租户、真实 NocoBase、真实权限、真实确认、真实回滚、真实 Trace 的端到端证据。没有 fresh verification,不能说完成。

### 4. Trace 不能只是日志展示

Trace 必须是执行证据账本,而不是页面上的调试文本。Trace 至少必须记录:

1. 原始请求。2. 统一计划。3. 模型与模型来源。4. 语义版本。5. schema 快照。6. 权限快照。7. confirmation contract。8. plan hash。9. provider 调用。10. 执行结果。11. 失败原因。12. 阶段耗时。13. 重新验证方式。

Trace revalidate 默认只能复放原计划。重新编译只能作为对比模式,不能冒充原请求验证。

### 5. AI coding 不能靠自觉

后续 AI coding 必须被 contract、静态扫描、RED/GREEN 测试、发布证据、门禁命令约束。不能依赖执行者自称已经完成。凡是没有证据的结论,必须标注为"未验证"。

## 三、可复用资产

以下能力有保留价值,但必须重新纳入统一运行时边界:

1. NocoBase provider 和连接配置能力。
2. 业务语义抽取、候选语义、来源证据、影响预览、发布流程。
3. 业务语义治理页面与 source drift 思路。
4. 确认卡、确认 token、confirmation contract。
5. 审计事件和操作记录。
6. 回滚预览和回滚执行思路。
7. Semantic Trace 页面和运行监控思路。
8. 文件、图片、文档、表格解析到业务输入 artifact 的思路。
9. 看板、导入导出、工作流、工具、Skills、多 Agent 的产品入口。
10. 历史失败样本、测试矩阵、smoke runner、发布证据文档。

这些资产可以复用其业务经验和产品形态,但不能继续保留绕过统一计划、统一门禁、统一证据链的执行路径。

## 四、后续修复硬性规定

### 1. 业务数据 provider 只能有一个运行时出口

所有触达 NocoBase 或业务底座的读、写、预览、确认、导入、导出、看板刷新、回滚、Trace revalidate、workflow、operation graph、工具、Skills,都必须经过统一业务数据运行时门禁。

目标链路:

```text
入口 Adapter
→ UnifiedOperationPlan
→ BusinessDataRuntimeGate
→ Preview / Confirmation
→ Executor
→ Provider
→ Audit / Trace / Rollback
```

命名对齐:本节与第五、六节中的 `UnifiedOperationPlan` 是 2026-07-08 原件的目标工件名;当前权威目标执行链以 `docs/release-plan.md`「目标执行链与不可变约束」为准——不可变 `CanonicalOperationPlan`(连同 NormalizedCommand、GatePermit、EffectIntent、EffectRuntimeKernel)是该工件链的现行形态与命名。现存代码中基于本地词表的 UOP 实现是待修复现状(release-plan 风险 SEM-01…08),不是达标依据。两处链路描述冲突时,以 release-plan 为准。

禁止入口直接调用:

```text
query_nocobase_records
execute_nocobase_record_mutation
execute_nocobase_business_object_create
list_nocobase_object_mappings
save_nocobase_object_mapping
```

测试、smoke、治理脚本可以触达 provider,但必须登记在显式白盒清单 `docs/qa/provider-whitebox-allowlist.json`(每条含文件、行为、用途;清单的创建与条目增改均属 L3,须用户确认),不能成为运行时后门。烧尽指标 A 的扣除只认该清单。

### 2. 所有入口只能生成 operation 或治理候选

Agent 对话、WebSocket、Channel、右侧工作区、确认卡、Trace revalidate、连接器页面、mapped records query、业务对象创建、看板、文件上传、导入导出、回滚、workflow、operation graph、工具、Skills、多 Agent,都只能生成以下之一:

1. UnifiedOperationPlan。2. WorkbenchOperation。3. GovernanceCandidate。4. SemanticCandidate。5. TraceGovernanceIssue。

入口本身不能直接判断可执行性,不能直接读写业务底座。

### 3. 语义分三层管理

业务语义词(对象、字段、动作、枚举、别名、阻断词、业务上下文词)必须来自已发布业务语义或系统通用语义包。

语义表达规则(时间、数量、范围、排序、分页、前 N 条、分别赋值、上下文引用、对应记录)必须来自集中语义表达规则库。

技术 contract(plan_hash、ACL、schema_verified、confirmation_contract、trace_id、rollback_plan、provider_write_executed、direct_write_executed)可以留在代码里,但不能包含业务词。

### 4. 缺关键事实必须阻断

缺业务语义、缺表达规则、缺 schema、缺权限、缺确认、缺 plan_hash、缺 confirmation_contract、缺 rollback_plan、缺 trace、缺 live mapping 时,运行时必须阻断。阻断后只能生成治理证据,不能 fallback 执行。

### 5. 旧 mapping 不能成为运行时事实

旧 object mapping、历史 trace、LLM 猜测、历史候选、旧 TenantSetting mapping,只能作为治理证据或迁移候选。Agent 可操作对象只能来自:

```text
active published ontology mapping
+ live schema exists
+ runtime_eligible=true
+ ACL/capability 校验通过
+ RuntimeGate 通过
```

### 6. 旧路径必须删除、阻断或降级

旧 API、旧 fallback、legacy path、deterministic fallback、schema-grounded fallback、直接 provider 调用,如果还需要保留 UI 或兼容入口,必须改成:生成治理候选 / 生成统一计划 / 返回阻断证据 / 跳转到治理页面。不能继续进入真实业务数据执行。

### 7. 多入口不是问题,多执行链路才是问题

系统可以保留多个产品入口(Agent、工作区、Trace、workflow、看板、文件上传、工具、Skills),但这些入口必须收敛到同一套运行时契约。入口可以多,执行链路只能有一条。

## 五、功能落地模板

后续任何业务数据相关功能必须按以下模板实现:

```text
1. 输入入口:接收用户请求、按钮、文件、workflow 事件或工具调用
2. 归一化:转成标准 Command
3. 语义解析:只读取发布语义和表达规则
4. 生成计划:UnifiedOperationPlan
5. RuntimeGate:校验 schema、ACL、mapping、确认需求、回滚能力、审计能力
6. 预览:只展示将要做什么,不写业务底座
7. 确认:校验 confirmation_contract 和 plan_hash
8. 执行:唯一 Executor 调 provider
9. 证据:写 audit、trace、rollback snapshot
10. 失败:阻断并生成治理项
```

UnifiedOperationPlan 至少包含:对象、字段、关系、筛选、record ids、每个目标的更新值、权限需求、schema 需求、模型来源、trace id、plan hash、回滚计划。

## 六、重构顺序

后续修复必须按风险边界推进:

1. 定义并落地 UnifiedOperationPlan、BusinessDataRuntimeGate、ProviderPort、TraceEvent、RollbackPlan。
2. 收敛所有 NocoBase provider 调用。
3. 收敛单表查询。
4. 收敛单条新增、修改、删除。
5. 收敛批量修改和多目标分别赋值。
6. 收敛多表关联查询。
7. 收敛文件解析到候选 operation。
8. 收敛语义治理发布闭环。
9. 收敛 Trace revalidate。
10. 收敛 workflow、operation graph、工具、Skills、多 Agent。
11. 收敛看板、导入导出、外发。
12. 做全域 fresh verification。

不能在统一运行时内核稳定前继续扩展高风险业务数据功能。

## 七、验证门禁

后续每个修复 Task 必须满足:

1. 有入口 inventory。
2. 有 provider touchpoint inventory。
3. 有本地词表和正则 inventory。
4. 有 RED test。
5. RED test 先失败,且失败原因匹配目标缺口。
6. 实现后 GREEN。
7. 有 fresh verification。
8. 有证据文档更新。
9. 有静态扫描证明未新增本地业务词表或 provider 后门。
10. git diff 中每个改动都能对应到本 Task 目标。

禁止通过以下方式通过门禁:

1. 删除测试。2. 放宽断言。3. 跳过 E2E。4. 关闭功能。5. 新增 fallback。6. 硬编码业务词。7. 扩大权限。8. 改文档冒充完成。9. 只测 mock 不测真实链路。10. 把失败放到后续处理。

## 八、AI coding 执行纪律

后续 AI coding 必须遵守:

1. 没有 full inventory,不准说范围完整。
2. 没有 RED/GREEN,不准说修复完成。
3. 没有 fresh verification,不准说完成。
4. 没有证据文档,不准说可交付。
5. 发现新入口、新 provider、新 fallback、新本地词表,必须停止并更新范围。
6. 不能使用"基本、差不多、大概率、看起来、只剩这些、可上线、全部统一"等模糊结论。
7. 不能把复杂问题缩小成当前文件的小修。
8. 不能把运行时问题转移成文档问题。
9. 不能把治理候选当成运行时事实。
10. 不能把测试替身当成真实验证。

## 九、最终判断纪律

系统级结论只有两种:"达到正式可用级别"或"不能确认完成"。判定依据是第十节的 19 条发版门禁。如果任一条件不满足,最终结论必须写:

```text
不能确认完成。
```

并列出未满足项、证据和下一条验证命令。

## 十、发版门禁(19 条)

只有同时满足以下 19 条,才允许声称系统——或其任何子系统(含"业务数据运行时")——达到正式可用级别:

1. 所有业务数据入口已纳入统一 operation。
2. 所有 provider 调用已纳入统一 RuntimeGate。
3. 所有业务语义词来自发布语义或系统通用语义包。
4. 所有语言结构判断来自集中表达规则库。
5. 所有写操作都有预览、确认、plan hash、confirmation contract。
6. 所有写操作都有审计和回滚证据。
7. Trace 可以解释完整耗时、完整计划、完整执行链路。
8. Trace revalidate 默认复放原计划。
9. 旧 mapping 不能进入运行时。
10. 缺关键事实时全部阻断并生成治理证据。
11. 后端测试通过。
12. 前端测试通过。
13. 当前租户 smoke 通过。
14. 静态扫描确认没有新增本地业务词表或 provider 后门。
15. 发布证据文档完整记录。
16. **语义理解质量达标**:存在真实口语黄金评测集(首版 ≥200 句,覆盖 12 个功能域的读/写/歧义/阻断样本);意图路由准确率与槽位准确率达到 `docs/release-plan.md` 任务 G1 定义的阈值;阻断率与追问率有基线记录并在预算内。安全侧全部 fail-closed 的前提下,系统还必须"听得懂"——一个把大部分正常请求都阻断的系统同样不可发版。
17. **性能与成本预算达标**:核心链路(编译→门禁→预览)P95 延迟与单请求 LLM 调用成本有明确预算值(定义在 `docs/release-plan.md` 任务 G2),且 smoke 实测在预算内。
18. **真实环境验收通过**:`docs/runbooks/release-verification.md` 中全部人工验收项在真实租户、真实 NocoBase、真实 PostgreSQL、真实浏览器环境通过,并按手册要求留存证据。此条只能由人工执行,coding agent 不得代替判定。
19. **越权与凭据门禁**:任一已认证账号不得读取或改写其他租户的 agent、工具配置、trigger、凭据与业务数据;任何返回体不得包含解密后的密钥、token 或 secret;通用注册/创建入口不得绕过其专用校验函数;所有外部 callback 入口在缺少凭据时必须 fail-closed 而非放行。判据为 `docs/release-plan.md` 风险映射中 SEC-01…SEC-23 全部关闭且各有回归测试(SEC-16 为 SEC-08 的重复登记,已作废并入,随 SEC-08 关闭,实际 22 项),以及 `docs/runbooks/release-verification.md` 验收项 11 在真实环境用两个不同租户账号实测通过。

第 1–15 条继承自宪章原件第九节,措辞不变;第 16–18 条为 v2 新增,填补"安全但不可用"、"功能对但太慢太贵"、"仅在测试环境成立"三类发版风险。第 19 条为 2026-07-26 全量代码 review 后新增:原 18 条全部围绕业务数据运行时的契约与证据,**没有任何一条要求租户隔离与凭据保护**,因此在 SEC 系列全部敞开的情况下,前 18 条仍可能被逐条宣称满足。初始判据为 SEC-01…SEC-13;同日十域盘点(台账 RV-06)发现 SEC-14…SEC-23 属正文措辞覆盖的同类行为但不在判据内,经用户裁定判据扩为 SEC-01…SEC-23,消除正文与判据两张皮。

本节第 14 条与第七节验证门禁第 9 条共用同一句"静态扫描"。2026-07-26 全量代码 review 查明:语义硬编码 guard 的唯一仓库级强制测试因 root 与 `RUNTIME_DIRS` 双重拼接指向不存在的目录而**恒过**,且该测试从未进入 CI(`docs/release-plan.md` 风险 EVD-02,证据 `docs/qa/2026-07-26-full-code-review.md`)。**2026-07-26 用户裁定后,EVD-02 已拆为两半并只修复前半截**:「guard 恒过」已在 Task 01 之前作为前置项修复(证据 `docs/qa/2026-07-26-evd-02-semantic-guard-root-fix.md`,RED/GREEN/反证齐全),该测试现已能对已登记 blocked term 失败;「从未进 CI」半截收窄归入风险 EVD-03,仍归 Task 18。2026-07-29 HR-15 fresh 对抗复核又证明:guard 仍只扫 services,不能识别未列入样本 blocklist 的新本地词表/业务正则/语义判断,provider safety scanner 也未对真实仓库形成强制(证据 `docs/qa/2026-07-11-task-05-ab-compiler-takeover-evidence.md` §201)。据此:

- **单独运行现有 guard 的 `9 passed` 不构成第七节第 9 条的满足**。在 HR-15/Task 05 与 EVD-04/Task 18 分别关闭前,每个 Task 必须同时附上触及 runtime 文件的结构化 A/B 扫描和 provider import/call 扫描原始结果;只引用样本 blocklist GREEN 不得过门禁。该任务级补充取证用于避免任务顺序死锁,不替代两项仓库级风险的最终关闭。

## 十一、分级自主协议

`docs/release-plan.md` 中每个任务必须标注自主级别;未标注的任务一律按 L3 处理。

- **L1(agent 可连续执行,无需停顿)**:新增测试、文档更新、只读路径收敛(仅当不修改运行时代码;需改运行时代码即按 L2)、静态扫描、证据文件生成、inventory 盘点。
- **L2(可以执行,完成后必须报告再继续)**:运行时代码修改、新增阻断逻辑、UI 适配、表达规则库变更。「报告再继续」指:报告后可直接进入下一任务,无需等待用户回复。
- **L3(必须停下等用户确认后才能动手)**:删除旧路径、数据库迁移、权限/身份/密钥相关变更、对外部系统的真实写操作、发版门禁判定(此项按第十节第 18 条,最终只能由用户作出,agent 获任何确认后也不得代替判定)。

执行节奏:L1 任务可以连续批量推进;L2 任务逐个执行、逐个报告;遇到 L3 任务必须暂停并向用户说明将要做什么、影响范围、回退方式,得到明确确认后才能执行。任何任务执行中若发现实际风险高于标注级别(例如 L1 任务需要改运行时代码),必须就地升级处理,不得按原级别继续。任务级标注优先于活动类型分级:`docs/release-plan.md` 中标注 L3 的任务,其内一切动作(含为其新增测试)均按 L3;复合任务可按阶段分别标注(如 G2)。第八节第 3 条「没有 fresh verification 不准说完成」对所有级别无条件适用;L1 任务的 fresh verification 最低要求为给出改动 diff 与可复核产物路径,测试类改动须附本地运行输出。

## 追加规则

1. 后续每完成一个 `docs/release-plan.md` 中的任务,在「微任务验收记录」表尾追加一行,沿用五列格式(条目/日期/主题/结论/证据指针);条目列写 `R-NN(Task XX)` 或 `R-NN(G1)` 等,NN 为追加时读取表尾现有最大 R 编号 +1(首条为 R-01),并更新三个烧尽指标表(A/B/C)。若新行改变了「状态声明」节的事实基础,须在同一提交中同步修订状态声明。
2. 本文件只记状态行,禁止写长篇叙述;过程叙述与 RED/GREEN 详情写入 `docs/qa/` 证据文件,在指针列引用。
3. 结论列:新增 R-行只允许 `不能确认完成` 或 `验收通过(证据:…)` 两种。**`验收通过` 的唯一含义与写入权限**:它指该任务的通过标准已被当次证据完整覆盖,即该任务状态同批由「需重验/未开始」翻为「已有证据」;写入条件与 `docs/release-plan.md` 状态口径完全相同(同提交引用当次验证命令输出),不额外要求真实环境。它**不是**发版验收,也不是 `docs/runbooks/release-verification.md` 的人工验收——后者的结果按本文件规则记为人工验收登记行,由人工判定,coding agent 不得代写其结论。凡任务未达「已有证据」,结论列一律写 `不能确认完成`;「原文措辞」仅适用于既有历史压缩行(12.x)。禁止"基本完成、差不多"等模糊表述(见 charter 第八节)。
4. 跨任务的整体性 review 追加到「全量 review 记录」表,条目列写 `RV-NN`,结论列只允许 `不能确认完成`(review 不做验收,不存在通过结论)。review 若发现新风险,须在同一提交中并入 `docs/release-plan.md` 风险映射并各自指派主 Task;若发现既有风险已消除或部分缓解,只登记事实,**不得**据此修改任何任务的状态标签。

=== pyproject ===
[project]
name = "clawith-backend"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Backend workspace for the Clawith enterprise digital employee platform."
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = [
    "fastapi[standard]>=0.115.0",
    "uvicorn[standard]>=0.30.0",
    "sqlalchemy[asyncio]>=2.0.0",
    "asyncpg>=0.30.0",
    "alembic>=1.14.0",
    "redis[hiredis]>=5.0.0",
    "pydantic>=2.11.0",
    "pydantic-settings>=2.0.0",
    "python-jose[cryptography]>=3.3.0",
    "passlib[bcrypt]>=1.7.4",
    "python-multipart>=0.0.9",
    "httpx[socks]>=0.27.0",
    "docker>=7.0.0",
    "websockets>=13.0",
    "aiofiles>=24.0.0",
    "croniter>=2.0.0",
    "pyyaml>=6.0.0",
    "trafilatura>=1.12.0",
    "lxml>=5.0.0",
    "lxml-html-clean>=0.4.0",
    "PyNaCl>=1.5.0",
    "pdfplumber>=0.11.0",
    "PyMuPDF>=1.24.0",
    "python-docx>=1.1.0",
    "openpyxl>=3.1.0",
    # MinerU document/image extraction is locked to a governed service-compatible adapter over httpx.
    # MinerU owns its parsing/OCR/layout models; do not route them through the platform model pool.
    "python-pptx>=1.0.0",
    "lark-oapi>=1.2.9",
    "dingtalk-stream>=0.17.0",
    "wecom-aibot-sdk-python>=0.1.4",
    "pycryptodome>=3.20.0",
    "loguru>=0.7.0",
    "discord.py>=2.3.0",
    "wuying-agentbay-sdk>=0.18.0",
    "pypinyin>=0.52.0",
    "anyascii>=0.3.2",
    "Pillow>=10.0.0",
    "weasyprint>=62.0",
    "markdown>=3.6",
    "beautifulsoup4>=4.12.0",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
teams = [
    "azure-identity>=1.15.0",
]
dev = [
    "pytest>=8.0.0",
    "pytest-asyncio>=0.24.0",
    "httpx>=0.27.0",
    "ruff>=0.8.0",
]

[tool.ruff]
target-version = "py311"
line-length = 120

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
asyncio_mode = "auto"

[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=68.0", "wheel"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
include = ["app*"]

=== docs/runbooks/release-verification.md ===
# 真实环境发版验收手册

更新日期:2026-07-26

**本手册是 `docs/charter.md` 发版门禁第 18 条的执行载体,必须由人工在真实环境执行;coding agent 不能代替执行,也不得代替判定结果。** agent 的职责仅限于:维护本手册与 `docs/release-plan.md` 的一致性、准备环境与脚本(release-plan 任务 G3)、把人工执行结果登记进 `docs/progress-ledger.md` 与 `docs/qa/`。

本手册覆盖的正是收敛计划 318 条微任务记录里反复声明"仍未验证"的固定维度:真实 tenant / 真实 NocoBase / PostgreSQL(原子持久化)/ frontend + browser E2E / 完整 backend(WebSocket/Channel)/ deployment 与 release smoke / 备份恢复 / dirty diff 归属。

## 环境清单(全部就绪才可开始)

| 项 | 要求 | 就绪判据 |
|---|---|---|
| 真实租户 | 非 fixture 的企业租户,含真实组织成员与角色 | 能以管理员和普通员工两种身份登录 |
| 真实 NocoBase | 生产或等价环境的 NocoBase 实例,含真实业务表 | 连接器配置页可见 collection,ACL 快照可同步 |
| PostgreSQL | 15+,非 SQLite | `alembic upgrade head` 在该库干净通过 |
| Redis | 7+ | 后端启动日志无连接错误 |
| 浏览器 | Chrome/Chromium 最新版 | Playwright E2E 可启动 |
| 部署配置 | `deploy/business-data-smoke-cases.production.json` 与 fixtures 从 example 实例化并填入真实值 | `scripts/validate-production-config.py` 通过;并确认 `deploy/business-data-smoke-cases.production.example.json:25` 的真实租户 UUID 已被替换为占位值(见 `docs/qa/2026-07-26-code-review-followup.md` §4) |
| 备份能力 | 数据库与 Agent workspace 可备份、可恢复 | 见验收项 8 |

## 验收项

每项执行后在 `docs/qa/` 留存证据(命名:`YYYY-MM-DD-release-verification-<项号>-<主题>.md` 或 `.json`,含命令输出、截图路径、执行人、git SHA)。

各验收项对应的 release-plan 任务(失败回写用):项 1–2 ↔ Task 19;项 3 ↔ Task 19 与 G3;项 4 ↔ Task 03/06;项 5 ↔ Task 02/06;项 6 ↔ Task 04/06;项 7 ↔ Task 10/11;项 8 ↔ G3(备份能力)与 Task 19;项 9 ↔ Task 19;项 10 ↔ G1/G2;项 11 ↔ Task 08/10/11/12/13/16/17(按 `docs/release-plan.md` 风险映射的主 Task 反查:SEC-01/10→08、SEC-05/06/07→10、SEC-11/12→11、SEC-02/03/17/18→12、SEC-04/22/23→13、SEC-09→16、SEC-08/13/14/15/19/20/21→17,SEC-16 并入 SEC-08;失败时只回写该失败子项对应的那个 Task,不得整列退回)。

### 1. 后端全量测试(真实 PostgreSQL)

- 步骤:环境变量指向真实 PostgreSQL,执行命令。
- 命令:`cd backend && .venv/bin/pytest -q`
- 预期结果:0 failed、0 error、0 collection error。2026-07-26 的收集错误已随工作区归属提交(`cfd05827`)修复,归属后 `pytest --collect-only` 为 5807 collected, 0 error;失败用例基线见 `docs/progress-ledger.md` 指标 C 表。
- 证据:完整输出尾部 + JUnit XML。

### 2. 前端测试、构建与浏览器 E2E

- 步骤:安装依赖后依次执行。
- 命令:`cd frontend && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e`
- 预期结果:vitest 全通过;tsc+vite build 无错误;Playwright E2E 全通过。
- 证据:三段命令输出 + Playwright report 目录归档。

### 3. 生产 smoke(真实租户 + 真实 NocoBase)

- 步骤:确认 smoke 配置指向真实环境,执行 runner(runner 内建语义 trace 阶段断言 input_intent→outcome)。
- 命令:`python scripts/run-business-data-smoke.py --config deploy/business-data-smoke-cases.production.json`
- 预期结果:退出码 0;case 集覆盖 Task 19 通过标准的全部维度(读、单/批写、ACL、两类看板、文件扫描/解析、import/export/send、rollback、Search 主/降级、notification、Graph 部分失败与 cleanup),缺任一维度即记为失败;所有 case 的 trace 阶段完整;无 unknown/manual_required 残留。
- 证据:runner 输出 JSON 存 `docs/qa/`。

### 4. 端到端手工链路:读

- 步骤:以普通员工身份在 Web 对话中用口语查询业务表(含翻页、"更多"、详情引用);在无权限字段上重复同样查询。
- 预期结果:结果与 NocoBase 后台一致;无权限字段不出现;每次查询在 Semantic Trace 页可见完整链路(计划、语义版本、ACL 快照、耗时)。
- 证据:截图 + 对应 trace_id 列表。

### 5. 端到端手工链路:写 + 确认 + 回滚

- 步骤:口语发起单条修改与批量修改(含"分别改成"类多目标),走预览→确认;确认后在审计页找到记录;对已执行的写操作执行回滚预览与回滚。
- 预期结果:未确认前 NocoBase 数据不变;确认后变更准确;部分失败时状态如实分组;回滚后数据恢复,回滚本身有审计与 trace。
- 证据:NocoBase 前后数据截图 + 审计记录 + 回滚 trace_id。

### 6. 阻断行为(fail-closed)

- 步骤:对未发布语义的表发起写操作;删除某发布 mapping 后重试查询;以无权限身份发起高风险操作。
- 预期结果:全部阻断,给出稳定 reason code 并生成治理候选/治理证据;无任何 fallback 执行;NocoBase 无变化。
- 证据:阻断响应截图 + 治理页新增候选截图。

### 7. IM 渠道一致性(至少一个真实渠道:飞书或钉钉或企微)

- 步骤:同一账号绑定的 IM 中发起与验收项 4/5 相同的读写请求,用卡片完成确认。
- 预期结果:IM 与 Web 生成同一父级操作与同一确认 identity;卡片确认后结果一致;渠道 callback 验签生效(伪造请求被拒且不产生任何 command/LLM 调用)。
- 证据:IM 截图 + trace 对照。

### 8. 备份恢复

- 步骤:备份 PostgreSQL 与 Agent workspace;在隔离环境恢复;抽查关键表行数与最近 audit/trace 记录。
- 预期结果:恢复后应用可启动,抽查数据一致。
- 证据:备份/恢复命令输出 + 抽查对照表。

### 9. 部署与发布证据闭环

- 步骤:按当前部署方式(参见 helm/ 与 restart.sh)完成一次干净部署;核对发布证据 manifest。
- 预期结果:manifest 含 git SHA、镜像 digest、plan/effect/receipt/audit/trace refs、截图与 cleanup 记录;git SHA 与部署实例一致;工作区无未归属 dirty diff。2026-07-26 的 dirty diff 已归属完毕(六个提交,见 `docs/release-plan.md` Task 19「工作区归属」),但该表第 3、5、6 行仍有未处置项(websocket 预路由退化、example 校验缺失、遗留 stash),本项通过前必须清完。
- 证据:manifest 文件存 `docs/qa/`。

### 10. 理解质量与性能预算(依赖 release-plan G1/G2 完成)

- 步骤:在真实环境跑 G1 评测集与 G2 阶段耗时统计。
- 预期结果:各项指标达到 release-plan G1/G2 定义阈值;超标项有量化记录与用户裁定。
- 证据:评测结果 JSON + 耗时分位数 JSON。

### 11. 越权与凭据暴露(2026-07-26 全量 review 新增)

- 依据:`docs/qa/2026-07-26-full-code-review.md` §3 登记的 SEC-01…SEC-09,`docs/qa/2026-07-26-code-review-followup.md` §1 登记的 SEC-10 与 §7 登记的 SEC-11…SEC-13,以及 `docs/qa/2026-07-26-ten-domain-audit.md` 登记的 SEC-14…SEC-23(2026-07-26 经用户裁定并入门禁 19 判据;SEC-16 为 SEC-08 重复登记,其实测即第 7 步)。本项是 charter 门禁第 19 条的真实环境判据。以下每条都必须在真实环境用两个不同租户的账号实际尝试,不能以代码阅读代替。
- 步骤与预期结果:
  1. 用租户 A 的普通员工账号,对租户 B 的 agent 调 `GET /api/tools/agents/{agent_id}/tool-config/{tool_id}` 与 `PUT` 同路径 → 必须 403/404,且响应体中不出现任何解密后的凭据(SEC-03)。
  2. 同账号对租户 B 的 agent 调 `GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/agents/{agent_id}/triggers/...` → 必须 403/404,响应不含 webhook `token`/`secret`(SEC-04)。
  3. 以普通员工身份注册 `source_type="cli"` 且 `command` 为 shell 的工具源 → 必须在注册时即被拒(SEC-02)。
  4. 上传文件名含单引号与 `../` 的文件 → 必须被拒或安全化落盘,且后端主机上无对应进程被拉起、无 uploads 目录外的文件写入(SEC-01)。
  5. 向已配置 `verification_token` 的飞书 callback 发送**不带 token 字段**的伪造事件;向 DingTalk、Teams callback 发送无凭证的伪造事件 → 三者均必须被拒,且不产生 command、operation、LLM 或 provider 调用(SEC-05、SEC-07)。
  6. 重启后端进程后重放此前已处理过的渠道 event;在多副本部署下向不同副本发送同一 event → 必须均被判重复(SEC-06)。
  7. 用另一台设备/浏览器持 `sid` 调 `GET /sso/session/{sid}/status`;并发两次调用同一已授权 session → 必须分别被拒与只有一次拿到 token(SEC-08)。
  8. 对某次外发提交一条 `provider_message_id` 与原记录不符的伪造回执 → 必须不被接受、不回填、不改变原 delivery 状态(SEC-09)。
  9. 用租户 A 的普通员工账号向租户 B 的 agent 调 `POST /chat/upload` 上传文件 → 必须 403/404,且租户 B 的 `workspace/uploads/` 下不出现新文件(SEC-10)。注意 SEC-01 的修复只覆盖文件名与路径,不覆盖越权,本条必须单独实测。
  10. 以租户 A 的账号调 `GET /api/agents/{A 的 agent}/collaborators` → 返回列表中不得出现任何租户 B 的 agent(SEC-11)。
  11. 以租户 A 的账号,用自己的 agent 作来源、租户 B 的 agent 作 `to_agent_id`,分别调 `POST /api/agents/{id}/collaborate/delegate` 与 `/collaborate/message` → 均必须被拒;事后检查租户 B 的 agent 无新增 Task,且其 `workspace/inbox/` 下无新文件(SEC-12)。这一条必须实际查文件系统,只看响应码不够。
  12. 以 agent creator 身份调 `POST /api/agents/{id}/handover`,`new_creator_id` 填另一租户的用户 → 必须被拒,`agent.creator_id` 不变(SEC-13)。
  13. 新建一个**未配置任何 governance policy** 的租户,用其普通成员账号发起受治理的高危操作(如 NocoBase 角色变更确认、外部写确认)→ 必须默认拒绝并生成治理候选/明确报错,不得以 `compatibility_no_policies` 之类兼容理由放行(SEC-14)。
  14. 以租户管理员身份调渠道配置读取端点与 `GET /identity-providers` → 响应体不得含 `app_secret`/`encrypt_key`/`verification_token`/`client_secret` 等任何明文或解密后 secret(掩码/省略均可)(SEC-15、SEC-19)。
  15. 用租户 A 的账号调 `GET /tools?tenant_id={租户 B}` 与 `POST /tools`(payload 带租户 B 的 tenant_id)→ 必须 403/404 或强制回落到 A 自己的租户,不得返回租户 B 的解密 config、不得在租户 B 名下创建工具;再调 `PUT /tools/bulk` 携带租户 B 的工具 ID → 租户 B 工具的启停状态必须不变(SEC-17、SEC-18)。
  16. 用租户 A 的管理员账号调 `PATCH /org/users/{租户 B 的用户 id}` → 必须 403/404,目标用户资料不变;再用一个**未加入任何企业**(tenant_id 为空)的注册账号调 `GET /org/users` → 必须拒绝或返回空,不得返回其他租户的用户列表(SEC-20、SEC-21)。
  17. 以能读某 agent 详情的账号取其 `api_key_hash` 字段值,将该值作为 `X-Api-Key` 调 OpenClaw 网关 poll/report/send → 必须认证失败;且 agent 详情响应体中不应再返回 `api_key_hash`(SEC-22)。
  18. 在租户 B 发送一条 agent 消息后,在租户 A 配置 `from_agent_name` 与租户 B agent 同名的 on_message 触发器并等待其运行 → 租户 A 的触发器上下文与产出中不得出现租户 B 的任何消息内容(SEC-23)。
- 证据:每条的请求/响应原文(凭据字段须打码)+ 执行人 + git SHA。

## 判定

- 全部 11 项通过 → charter 门禁第 18 条满足;其中验收项 11 同时是门禁第 19 条(越权与凭据)的真实环境判据。连同第 1–17 条与第 19 条一起复核后,才可由**用户**作出发版判定(L3)。
- 任一项失败 → 结论写"不能确认完成",失败项按上文「各验收项对应的 release-plan 任务」回写:对应任务原状态为「已有证据」的退回「需重验」;原状态本就非「已有证据」的保持原状态,不得借回写升级;两种情况都必须在 `docs/progress-ledger.md` 追加失败记录。
- 本手册与 release-plan 不一致时,以先修订文档、再执行为准;不得现场即兴替换验收标准。

=== release-plan head constraints ===
# 可执行发版计划

更新日期:2026-08-09。执行前必读 `docs/charter.md`(约束与 19 条门禁)与 `docs/progress-ledger.md`(当前状态)。

## 目标执行链与不可变约束

继承收敛计划原件 §2/§3(`docs/archive/plans/2026-07-10-business-data-runtime-kernel-convergence.md`)。

目标执行链:

```text
Entry Adapter
-> NormalizedCommand
-> SemanticRuntimeSnapshot(A release + B release + C catalog)
-> CanonicalOperationPlan
-> BusinessDataRuntimeGate / Domain Policy Gate
-> Preview
-> ConfirmationGrant (mutation only)
-> atomic grant consume + ExecutionLease + EffectIntent commit
-> EffectRuntimeKernel
-> ProviderPort
-> EffectReceipt
-> AuditEvent + TraceEvent
-> CompensationCoordinator / Reconciler
```

12 条不可变约束:

1. 所有业务数据 read/write 必须先形成不可变 `CanonicalOperationPlan`,再经过 `BusinessDataRuntimeGate`。
2. 所有外部或本地持久化副作用必须经过同一 `EffectRuntimeKernel`;业务数据 Gate 是该内核的强制策略阶段,不是旁路 helper。
3. API、WebSocket、Channel、worker、workflow、Graph、Tool、Skill、MCP、smoke 只能提交 command 或 operation,不能直接调用 raw provider。
4. `ProviderPort` 只接受一次性 `GatePermit` 和已持久化 `EffectIntent`;没有 permit 的 provider 调用必须失败。
5. 所有 read 也必须有 plan、ACL、scope 和 pre-effect evidence;read 不要求用户确认,但不能在 Gate 前触达 provider。
6. 所有 mutation 必须有确认授权、执行租约、幂等键、回滚或补偿声明、Trace 和 audit。
7. 不宣称跨 provider exactly-once;外部副作用使用 durable intent、幂等键、receipt、reconcile、`unknown` 状态和 saga compensation。
8. 不可补偿 effect 不能与其他 effect 组成可执行 Operation Graph;在 preview 阶段阻断并生成治理证据。
9. Runtime 只读取不可变的已发布 A/B 语义快照;candidate、historical mapping、live schema 猜测和本地 A/B 词表不得成为执行事实。
10. Search/RAG 技术降级只能返回带 `degraded` evidence 的只读结果;降级结果不能成为写授权、ACL 事实或"已权限过滤"声明。
11. 缺语义、表达规则、schema、live mapping、ACL、plan identity、确认、rollback/compensation、Trace 或 provider evidence 时 fail-closed 并生成治理项。
12. 兼容 URL 只允许转成统一 operation、治理候选或明确阻断;禁止回退旧执行链。

## 风险映射(168 项 = 原始 83 + 2026-07-26 review 新增 23 + 2026-07-26 十域盘点新增 27 + 2026-07-26 前端 UI/UX 盘点新增 30 + 2026-07-27 Task 01 执行期新增 2 + 2026-07-28 sidecar 一致性审计新增 2 + 2026-07-29 scheduler/OKR legacy 审计新增 1)

原始 83 项来源:归档台账 §64 唯一修复决策表(`docs/archive/qa/2026-07-09-phase-0-runtime-kernel-audit-ledger.md` 行 10202–10336)。§64 原表无 Task 列;下表 Task 归属取自收敛计划 §8 各任务「风险:」声明与 §9 完整映射表(两源经核对完全一致)。83 项 = SFX 29 + SEM 24 + HR 29 + EVD 1,每项恰有一个主 Task。

风险状态列口径:原始 83 项与新增 85 项(review 23 + 十域盘点 27 + 前端盘点 30 + Task 01 执行期 2 + sidecar 一致性审计 2 + scheduler/OKR legacy 审计 1)用**两套互不混用**的词:

- 原始 83 项只用四个值:`已消除` = 目标形态在代码中成立且有测试;`部分缓解` = 部分子条件已修、其余仍可复现(**不得据此翻任何任务状态**);`仍成立` = RED 可复现;`未复核` = 本轮未覆盖,状态保持原样。允许且仅允许一种限定写法:`仍成立(一条子结论不成立)`(全表仅 HR-25 使用),含义是该行主结论 RED 仍可复现、但原登记的某一条子结论经复核并不成立;**按 `仍成立` 处理**,不得据此删减该任务的任何 RED,被推翻的子结论明细见 §2。判决明细见 `docs/qa/2026-07-26-full-code-review.md` §2。
- 新增 85 项(review 23 + 十域盘点 27 + 前端盘点 30 + Task 01 执行期 2 + sidecar 一致性审计 2 + scheduler/OKR legacy 审计 1)只用 `未修复` = 本轮登记时即为 RED、且截至本文更新日未做任何修复。例外仅 review 23 项中的四条,其单元格直接写明修复提交或证据文件:SEC-01、EVD-02(EVD-02 只关闭「guard 恒过」这半截,其「从未进 CI」半截已收窄归入 EVD-03,仍为 `未修复`)、HR-30、HR-31(两处一行级 NameError,证据 `docs/qa/2026-07-26-hr-30-31-nameerror-fixes.md`;主任务 14/12 状态不变);十域盘点 27 项中 PERF-01 已完成 writer 单行链尾读取与并发复合索引迁移,其余保持原登记(SEC-16 作废行不在此列,其状态列写「并入 SEC-08」);前端盘点 30 项中例外两条:FE-01、FE-02 已随 `frontend/src/pages/Chat.tsx` 删除关闭,其单元格写明证据文件 `docs/qa/2026-07-26-chat-page-removal.md`,余 28 项为 `未修复`;Task 01 执行期 2 项中 EVD-05 已于登记当日修复,PERF-02 仅完成事实登记且未修复;sidecar 一致性审计 2 项与 scheduler/OKR legacy 审计 1 项均未修复。新增项不使用原始项那四个词:那四个词是对既有登记的复核判决,而新增项本身就是首次登记,不存在"复核"这一步。

无论哪一套,**该列都是事实登记列,不是验收列**:任何一行的取值都不使其所属任务前进一步,任务状态只由任务自身的通过标准决定。

与 charter 门禁第 19 条的关系:该条要求「SEC-01…SEC-23 全部关闭且各有回归测试」(**2026-07-26 经用户裁定由 SEC-01…SEC-13 扩围**,与其正文措辞对齐,台账 RV-06;SEC-16 为 SEC-08 的重复登记,随 SEC-08 关闭,不单独计)。这里的「关闭」指**该风险本身已修复并有当次通过的回归测试**,本列只是把这一事实登记下来;把单元格改成「已修复」而没有对应回归测试与证据文件,不构成关闭,也不使门禁第 19 条前进一步。反之,门禁第 19 条的满足只看这 22 项的关闭事实与 runbook 验收项 11,不额外要求其主 Task 整体达到「已有证据」。

=== backend Dockerfile ===
# ─── Backend Dockerfile (Optimized) ─────────────────────
# Multi-stage: deps → production
FROM python:3.12-slim AS deps

WORKDIR /app
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gcc libpq-dev libcairo2 libpango-1.0-0 libpangocairo-1.0-0 libgdk-pixbuf-2.0-0 shared-mime-info pango1.0-tools && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

COPY pyproject.toml ./
ARG CLAWITH_PIP_INDEX_URL
ARG CLAWITH_PIP_TRUSTED_HOST
RUN if [ -n "$CLAWITH_PIP_INDEX_URL" ] && [ -n "$CLAWITH_PIP_TRUSTED_HOST" ]; then \
        pip install --no-cache-dir --index-url "$CLAWITH_PIP_INDEX_URL" --trusted-host "$CLAWITH_PIP_TRUSTED_HOST" .; \
    elif [ -n "$CLAWITH_PIP_INDEX_URL" ]; then \
        pip install --no-cache-dir --index-url "$CLAWITH_PIP_INDEX_URL" .; \
    else \
        pip install --no-cache-dir .; \
    fi

# ─── Production ─────────────────────────────────────────
FROM python:3.12-slim AS production

WORKDIR /app
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libpq5 curl shadowsocks-libev gosu bubblewrap libcairo2 libpango-1.0-0 libpangocairo-1.0-0 libgdk-pixbuf-2.0-0 shared-mime-info pango1.0-tools fonts-wqy-microhei fonts-wqy-zenhei && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Copy installed packages from deps stage
COPY --from=deps /usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages/ /usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages/
COPY --from=deps /usr/local/bin/ /usr/local/bin/

# Copy application code
COPY . .

RUN useradd --create-home clawith && \
    mkdir -p /data/agents && \
    chmod +x /app/entrypoint.sh && \
    chown -R clawith:clawith /app /data

# Note: USER is removed to allow entrypoint.sh to fix permissions of mounted volumes
# at runtime. The entrypoint script will drop privileges to 'clawith' after fixing permissions.

# Health check
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --retries=3 \
    CMD curl -f http://localhost:8000/api/health || exit 1

EXPOSE 8000
# entrypoint.sh runs `alembic upgrade head` then `uvicorn`
ENTRYPOINT ["/bin/bash", "/app/entrypoint.sh"]
=== backend entrypoint.sh ===
#!/bin/bash
# Docker entrypoint: run DB migrations, then start the app.
# Order matters:
#   1. alembic upgrade head — apply all migrations (creates tables + schema changes)
#   2. uvicorn — starts the FastAPI app

set -e

# --- Permission fixing and privilege dropping ---
if [ "$(id -u)" = '0' ]; then
    echo "[entrypoint] Detected root user, fixing permissions..."
    chown -R clawith:clawith ${AGENT_DATA_DIR}

    echo "[entrypoint] Dropping privileges to 'clawith' and re-executing..."
    exec gosu clawith /bin/bash "$0" "$@"
fi
# -------------------------------------------------------

echo "[entrypoint] Step 1: Running alembic migrations..."
# Run all migrations to ensure database schema is up to date.
# Capture exit code explicitly — do NOT let a migration failure go unnoticed.
set +e
ALEMBIC_OUTPUT=$(alembic upgrade head 2>&1)
ALEMBIC_EXIT=$?
set -e

if [ $ALEMBIC_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "========================================================================"
    echo "[entrypoint] WARNING: Alembic migration FAILED (exit code $ALEMBIC_EXIT)"
    echo "========================================================================"
    echo ""
    echo "$ALEMBIC_OUTPUT"
    echo ""
    echo "------------------------------------------------------------------------"
    echo "  The database schema may be INCOMPLETE. Some features will NOT work."
    echo "  Common causes:"
    echo "    - Migration cycle detected (pull latest code to fix)"
    echo "    - Database connection issue"
    echo "    - Incompatible migration state"
    echo ""
    echo "  To fix: pull the latest code and restart the backend."
    echo "    Docker:  git pull && docker compose restart backend"
    echo "    Source:  git pull && alembic upgrade head"
    echo "------------------------------------------------------------------------"
    echo ""
    if [ "${INTENTHUB_ALLOW_MIGRATION_FAILURE:-false}" = "true" ]; then
        echo "[entrypoint] Continuing startup despite migration failure because INTENTHUB_ALLOW_MIGRATION_FAILURE=true."
    else
        echo "[entrypoint] Release mode migration failure blocks startup. Set INTENTHUB_ALLOW_MIGRATION_FAILURE=true only for local developer recovery."
        exit $ALEMBIC_EXIT
    fi
else
    echo "[entrypoint] Alembic migrations completed successfully."
fi

echo "[entrypoint] Step 2: Starting uvicorn..."
exec uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
=== frontend Dockerfile ===
FROM node:20-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --registry https://registry.npmmirror.com
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

FROM nginx:alpine
COPY --from=build /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]
=== frontend nginx.conf ===
server {
    listen 3000;
    server_name localhost;
    root /usr/share/nginx/html;
    index index.html;

    # Allow large file uploads (up to 100MB)
    client_max_body_size 500m;

    # SPA fallback — index.html must never be cached so users always get the latest build
    location / {
        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
        add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate";
        add_header Pragma "no-cache";
    }

    # Hashed assets (JS/CSS) — safe to cache for 1 year since filenames change on every build
    location /assets/ {
        expires 1y;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, immutable";
    }

    # API proxy
    location /api/ {
        proxy_pass http://backend:8000;
        proxy_set_header Host $http_host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        client_max_body_size 500m;
        proxy_read_timeout 120s;
        proxy_send_timeout 120s;
    }

    # Public pages proxy (no auth, served by backend)
    location /p/ {
        proxy_pass http://backend:8000;
        proxy_set_header Host $http_host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }

    # WeCom domain verification files
    # WeCom's ownership-check bot requests WW_verify_<token>.txt at the domain root.
    # This rule intercepts these requests before the SPA fallback and proxies them
    # to the backend, which serves the file content stored in the tenant's config.
    location ~ ^/WW_verify_[A-Za-z0-9]+\.txt$ {
        proxy_pass http://backend:8000/api/wecom-verify$request_uri;
        proxy_set_header Host $http_host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
    }

    # WebSocket proxy
    location /ws/ {
        proxy_pass http://backend:8000;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
        proxy_set_header Host $http_host;

        # Keep WebSocket alive for long-running agent sessions (1 hour)
        proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
        proxy_send_timeout 3600s;
    }
}

      http_proxy:
        from_secret: PROXY
      https_proxy:
        from_secret: PROXY
    commands:
      - git config --global core.compression 0
      - git config --global http.postBuffer 524288000
      - git clone --no-single-branch https://github.com/dataelement/Clawith.git .
      - git fetch --tags
      - git checkout $DRONE_COMMIT
      - echo "当前 commit $(git log --oneline -1)"
      - echo "上一个 tag $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || echo '无 tag')"

  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 2: 构建新旧版本 Docker 镜像
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  - name: build-images
    image: docker:24.0.6
    pull: if-not-exists

    privileged: true
    volumes:
      - name: docker-socket
        path: /var/run/docker.sock
      - name: docker-cache
        path: /var/cache/docker
    environment:
      http_proxy:
        from_secret: PROXY
      https_proxy:
        from_secret: PROXY
    commands:
      - echo "========================================"
      - echo "开始构建 Docker 镜像"
      - echo "事件 $DRONE_BUILD_EVENT"
      - echo "目标分支 $DRONE_BRANCH"
      - echo "提交 $DRONE_COMMIT_SHORT"
      - echo "========================================"

      # 获取上一个 tag
      - PREV_TAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || echo "")
      - |
        if [ -z "$PREV_TAG" ]; then
          echo "警告: 未找到历史 tag，升级测试将被跳过"
          echo "SKIP_UPGRADE_TEST=true" > .env.drone
          # 仅构建当前版本
          docker build -t clawith-backend:new --build-arg CLAWITH_PIP_INDEX_URL=https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple -f backend/Dockerfile ./backend
          docker build -t clawith-frontend:new -f frontend/Dockerfile ./frontend
          docker save -o clawith-backend-new.tar clawith-backend:new
          docker save -o clawith-frontend-new.tar clawith-frontend:new
          chmod 644 clawith-backend-new.tar clawith-frontend-new.tar
          echo "当前版本镜像构建完成"
          exit 0
        fi
      - echo "上一个 tag $PREV_TAG"
      - |
        echo "SKIP_UPGRADE_TEST=false" > .env.drone

      # --- 构建旧版本镜像 ---
      - echo "--- 构建旧版本镜像 ($PREV_TAG) ---"
      - git checkout $PREV_TAG
      - docker build -t clawith-backend:old --build-arg CLAWITH_PIP_INDEX_URL=https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple -f backend/Dockerfile ./backend
      - docker build -t clawith-frontend:old -f frontend/Dockerfile ./frontend
      - docker save -o clawith-backend-old.tar clawith-backend:old
      - docker save -o clawith-frontend-old.tar clawith-frontend:old
      - echo "旧版本镜像构建完成"

      # --- 构建当前版本镜像 ---
      - echo "--- 构建当前版本镜像 ($DRONE_COMMIT_SHORT) ---"
      - git checkout $DRONE_COMMIT
      - docker build -t clawith-backend:new --build-arg CLAWITH_PIP_INDEX_URL=https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple -f backend/Dockerfile ./backend
      - docker build -t clawith-frontend:new -f frontend/Dockerfile ./frontend
      - docker save -o clawith-backend-new.tar clawith-backend:new
      - docker save -o clawith-frontend-new.tar clawith-frontend:new
      - echo "当前版本镜像构建完成"

      # --- 输出文件清单 ---
      - echo "--- 镜像文件清单 ---"
      - chmod 644 *.tar
      - ls -lh *.tar
      - cat .env.drone

  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 3: 传输镜像文件到私有服务器
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  - name: scp-images
    image: appleboy/drone-scp
    pull: if-not-exists
    settings:
      host:
        from_secret: PRIVATE_SERVER_IP
      username: root
      password:
        from_secret: sshpwd
      port: 22
      command_timeout: 15m
      target: /opt/server/clawith-ci/
      source:
        - clawith-backend-new.tar
        - clawith-frontend-new.tar
        - clawith-backend-old.tar
        - clawith-frontend-old.tar
        - docker-compose.yml
        - .env.drone
      rm: false

trigger:
  branch:
    - main
    - release
    - feat-devops
  event:
    - push
    - pull_request

volumes:
  - name: docker-socket
    host:
      path: /var/run/docker.sock
  - name: docker-cache
    host:
      path: /var/cache/docker

---
# ============================================================
# Pipeline 2: 部署测试
# 验证当前分支代码能否通过 docker compose 完整部署并正常启动
# ============================================================
kind: pipeline
type: docker
name: deploy-test

depends_on:
  - build-and-test

workspace:
  path: /drone/src

clone:
  disable: true

steps:
  - name: deploy-test
    image: appleboy/drone-ssh
    pull: if-not-exists
    settings:
      host:
        from_secret: PRIVATE_SERVER_IP
      username: root
      password:
        from_secret: sshpwd
      command_timeout: 10m
      script:
        - echo "========================================"
        - echo "部署测试 全新部署验证"
        - echo "========================================"
        - CI_DIR=/opt/server/clawith-ci
        - DEPLOY_DIR=/opt/server/clawith-private
        - cd $DEPLOY_DIR || exit 1

        # --- 加载新版镜像 ---
        - echo "加载新版镜像..."
        - docker load -i $CI_DIR/clawith-backend-new.tar
        - docker load -i $CI_DIR/clawith-frontend-new.tar
        - rm -f $CI_DIR/clawith-backend-new.tar $CI_DIR/clawith-frontend-new.tar

        # --- 清理旧环境 ---
        - echo "清理旧环境..."
        - docker compose down -v --remove-orphans 2>/dev/null || true

        # --- 启动全部服务 ---
        - echo "启动全部服务 (postgres/redis/backend/frontend)..."
        - docker compose up -d --no-build
        - sleep 5

        # --- 等待基础设施就绪 ---
        - echo "等待 postgres 和 redis 健康检查通过..."
        - timeout 30s bash -c 'until [ "$(docker inspect --format="{{.State.Health.Status}}" $(docker compose ps -q postgres) 2>/dev/null)" = "healthy" ]; do sleep 2; done' || (echo "postgres 启动超时" && docker compose logs postgres && exit 1)
        - timeout 30s bash -c 'until [ "$(docker inspect --format="{{.State.Health.Status}}" $(docker compose ps -q redis) 2>/dev/null)" = "healthy" ]; do sleep 2; done' || (echo "redis 启动超时" && docker compose logs redis && exit 1)
        - echo "基础设施就绪"

        # --- 核心验证: backend 启动 ---
        - echo "等待 backend 启动 (最多 90 秒)..."
        - timeout 90s bash -c 'until docker compose logs --tail=200 backend 2>&1 | grep -q "Application startup complete"; do sleep 3; done'
        - RESULT=$?
        - |
          if [ $RESULT -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "❌ 部署测试失败: backend 启动超时"
            echo "--- backend 最近日志 ---"
            docker compose logs --tail=100 backend
            exit 1

def _log_bwrap_startup_status() -> None:
    """Emit a startup diagnostic for bubblewrap availability.

    We only warn when bwrap is missing so deployments can still start in
    degraded mode. The subprocess sandbox will fall back to the hardened local
    execution path in that case.
    """
    in_container = Path("/.dockerenv").exists()
    bwrap_path = shutil.which("bwrap")

    if bwrap_path:
        location = "container" if in_container else "host"
        logger.info(f"[startup] bubblewrap detected at {bwrap_path} ({location})")
        return

    if in_container:
        logger.warning(
            "[startup] bubblewrap (bwrap) is not installed in the backend container. "
            "The service will still start, but execute_code will run without bwrap filesystem isolation."
        )
        return

    logger.warning(
        "[startup] bubblewrap (bwrap) is not installed on the host. "
        "The service will still start, but execute_code will run without bwrap filesystem isolation."
    )


async def _start_ss_local() -> None:
    """Start ss-local SOCKS5 proxy for Discord API calls. Tries nodes in priority order."""
    import asyncio
    import json
    import os
    import tempfile

    if not shutil.which("ss-local"):
        logger.info("[Proxy] ss-local not found — Discord proxy disabled")
        return
    # Load proxy nodes from config file (gitignored, mounted as Docker volume)
    import json as _json
    cfg_file = os.environ.get("SS_CONFIG_FILE", "/data/ss-nodes.json")
    if os.path.exists(cfg_file):
        # Guard against empty or malformed config file — both produce a clear
        # warning and a clean exit rather than an unhandled JSONDecodeError.
        try:
            raw = open(cfg_file).read().strip()
            if not raw:
                logger.warning(f"[Proxy] {cfg_file} exists but is empty — skipping proxy")
                return
            nodes = _json.loads(raw)
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:
            logger.warning(f"[Proxy] Failed to parse {cfg_file}: {exc} — skipping proxy")
            return
        logger.info(f"[Proxy] Loaded {len(nodes)} node(s) from {cfg_file}")
    elif os.environ.get("SS_SERVER") and os.environ.get("SS_PASSWORD"):
        nodes = [{"server": os.environ["SS_SERVER"], "port": int(os.environ.get("SS_PORT", "1080")),
                  "password": os.environ["SS_PASSWORD"], "method": os.environ.get("SS_METHOD", "chacha20-ietf-poly1305"), "label": "env"}]
    else:
        logger.info(f"[Proxy] {cfg_file} not found and SS_SERVER not set — skipping proxy")
        return
    for node in nodes:
        cfg = {"server": node["server"], "server_port": node["port"], "local_address": "127.0.0.1",
               "local_port": 1080, "password": node["password"], "method": node["method"], "timeout": 10}
        tf = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode="w", suffix=".json", delete=False)
        json.dump(cfg, tf)
        tf.close()
        try:
            proc = await asyncio.create_subprocess_exec(
                "ss-local", "-c", tf.name,
                stdout=asyncio.subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE)
            await asyncio.sleep(2)
            if proc.returncode is None:
                os.environ["DISCORD_PROXY"] = "socks5h://127.0.0.1:1080"
                logger.info(f"[Proxy] ss-local → {node['label']} ({node['server']}:{node['port']})")
                return
            err = (await proc.stderr.read()).decode()[:120]
            logger.warning(f"[Proxy] {node['label']} failed: {err}")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"[Proxy] {node['label']} error: {e}")
    logger.warning("[Proxy] All SS nodes failed — Discord API calls will run without proxy")

3. Create a branch: `git checkout -b my-feature`
4. Make your changes
5. Push and open a Pull Request

## What Can I Contribute?
--
| 🌍 Translations | New languages or improving existing ones |
| 📖 Documentation | README, guides, code comments |
| 🧪 Tests | Unit tests, integration tests |

**New to the project?** Look for issues labeled [`good first issue`](https://github.com/dataelement/Clawith/labels/good%20first%20issue).

## Bug Reports
--

1. **Link an issue** — Create one first if it doesn't exist
2. **Keep it focused** — One PR per feature/fix
3. **Test your changes** — Make sure nothing is broken
4. **Follow code style:**
   - Backend: Python — formatted with `ruff`
   - Frontend: TypeScript — standard React conventions
5. Use `Fixes #<issue_number>` in the PR description

## Working on Multiple Features

It is common to develop several improvements in one sitting before submitting. Rather than sending one giant PR, please split your work into smaller, focused PRs — this makes review faster and merges cleaner.

### Preferred: one branch per feature from the start

```bash
# Start each new feature from a fresh branch off main
git checkout main && git pull
git checkout -b feat/i18n-emoji-cleanup

# ... develop, commit ...

git checkout main
git checkout -b feat/admin-email-templates

# ... develop, commit ...
```

Each branch becomes one PR. Small, clean, easy to review.

### Already mixed everything into one branch? Split it with `git add -p`

`git add -p` (patch mode) lets you selectively stage individual change *hunks* from a file — perfect for creating several commits from one messy branch.

**Step-by-step example:**

```bash
# Assume your branch is called my-big-branch and has 3 logical changes mixed in.
# Goal: create 3 separate PRs from it.

# --- PR 1: emoji cleanup ---
git checkout -b feat/i18n-emoji-cleanup main

# Interactively stage only the emoji-related hunks from en.json and zh.json:
git add -p frontend/src/i18n/en.json   # answer y/n for each hunk
git add -p frontend/src/i18n/zh.json
git commit -m "fix: remove emoji from i18n strings"
git push -u origin feat/i18n-emoji-cleanup
# → open PR

# --- PR 2: hardcoded strings → t() ---
git checkout -b feat/i18n-component-strings main

git add -p frontend/src/pages/AgentDetail.tsx   # stage only t() hunk
git add -p frontend/src/components/ChannelConfig.tsx
git commit -m "feat: replace hardcoded UI strings with i18n t() calls"
git push -u origin feat/i18n-component-strings
# → open PR

# --- PR 3: admin improvements ---
git checkout -b feat/admin-improvements main
git checkout my-big-branch -- frontend/src/pages/AdminCompanies.tsx  # cherry-pick whole file if clean
git commit -m "feat: improve admin company settings"
git push -u origin feat/admin-improvements
# → open PR
```

**Key commands:**

--
|---------|-------------|
| `git add -p <file>` | Stage hunks interactively (y = yes, n = no, s = split hunk smaller) |
| `git checkout <branch> -- <file>` | Copy a whole file from another branch |
| `git cherry-pick <commit>` | Apply a single commit to the current branch |
| `git diff main...HEAD -- <file>` | Preview what changed in a specific file vs main |

### Tips

- **Commit early, commit often** on your dev branch — individual commits are much easier to cherry-pick later than one large commit.
- Use descriptive commit messages (e.g. `fix: remove emoji from zh.json`, not `update stuff`).
- If two features touch the same file heavily, submit PR 1 first, wait for it to merge, then rebase PR 2 on `main` before opening it.
